items.title: Consumer outlook plunges in September as inflation outlook worsens
items.body: The survey's headline index hit a level of 47.8, down 7.5% from the August reading and off 13.2% from a year ago.

items.title: Record U.S. cyclosporiasis outbreak is over, CDC says
items.body: The largest outbreak, linked to shredded iceberg lettuce from Taylor Farms, sickened more than 12,000 people.

items.title: Inflation persisted in August, potentially locking in a Fed interest rate hike
items.body: The all-items consumer price index was expected to rise 0.4% in August, with core, excluding food and energy, showing a 0.2% gain, according to the Dow Jones consensus.

items.title: Friday's CPI inflation report is even more important than usual. Here's what to expect
items.body: The Bureau of Labor Statistics will release the August consumer price index report at 8:30 a.m.

items.title: The likelihood of a Fed interest rate hike next week just got a lot higher
items.body: Traders pushed chances for a rate increase to 70% in morning action.

items.title: Wholesale prices rose 0.4% in August, as expected
items.body: The producer price index was expected to rise 0.4% in August, according to the Dow Jones consensus forecast.

items.title: U.S. reveals import ban on slew of Canadian goods as trade war escalates
items.body: Import bans on motorbikes, alcohol and dairy products are due to come into effect on Sept. 29 as the rift between the countries deepens.

items.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs worth CA$27.6 billion take effect as trade rift with U.S. deepens
items.body: Duties on Canadian imports of U.S. steel and aluminum products have doubled to 50% as a trade war between Washington and Ottawa intensifies.
